text:
maria: Hey @channel — quick Q, I'm seeing lots of 0-length KV-cache spans for the prefetcher service in the UI, and some requests show up with no child spans. Where should I look for the raw traces/logs and the dashboards for this flow? any recent sampling changes?

aj: @maria, short answer: dashboards -> Observability > Traces > service:prefetcher. For raw traces use our Jaeger UI (https://jaeger.internal.redwood/trace/) and click the trace ID to view spans. For logs, Kibana > logs > service:prefetcher.

maria: thanks — i'm looking for the specific kvcache child spans (kvcache.get / kvcache.prefetch). they used to show up under "prefetcher.kv" service in Jaeger but now duration is 0 for a lot.

observability-bot: FYI: Sampling rollout (sampler=v2_probability) was applied to pref-pool canary at 2025-11-17T03:08:12Z by infra-deploy. See: https://console.redwood/internal/deploys/3712 :deploy:

aj: hmm could be sampler misconfig or instrumentation bug. Two quick things to check: 1) confirm OTEL SDK sampler envs on the pref servers (OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER, OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG). 2) dump a few spans locally with `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` pointing to dev collector and see if child spans are generated before export.

maria: where exactly is the sampler env set? helm values?

aj: it's in the k8s secret for pref-deployment, key `otel-sampling`. ops changed the default to 0.05 in the canary. run: `kubectl -n svc-pref get secret pref-deploy -o yaml | yq .data.otel-sampling | base64 -d`

maria: ok I pulled it, shows `{ "sampler": "parentbased_traceidratio", "ratio": 0.05 }` — that explains fewer child spans but not zero duration.

kendall: zero duration usually means missing start/finish pair or the instrumentation is using different tracer name. Can you grep for `span.Start` vs `span.End` in the prefetcher repo? Also check that KV lib isn't creating a new tracer with a different service name.

maria: quick grep: `kvcache.go` calls `tracer.Start(ctx, "kvcache.get")` and defers `span.End()` — seems ok.

aj: another angle: samplers can cause spans to be created but not sampled/persisted — those show up with 0 duration in some UIs because only meta was reported. Can you check the OTLP exporter logs on the pod (`/var/log/otel-collector.log`) for any export errors or truncated payloads?

maria: tail of collector log shows intermittent `rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted` around 03:10 UTC.

observability-bot: Alert created: `prefetcher_export_errors` fired 2025-11-17T03:11Z. Link: https://alerts.redwood/alerts/4789

maria: that matches the window. so maybe collector dropped spans during canary load test and some span metadata remained. What should I do to confirm?

aj: Reproduce with sampling set to 1.0 locally (or in a test namespace) and hit the same endpoints. If child spans appear, then it's likely exporter rate-limited. Steps:
```
# in test ns
kubectl set env deploy/prefetcher OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_on -n svc-pref-test
# run a short load
wrk -t2 -c20 -d30s https://pref-test.internal/prime
# check jaeger for kvcache spans
```

kendall: also check the collector CPU/memory metrics during the incident window: Grafana > Infra > otel-collector > `collector_ingest_errors`, and check `exporter_send_errors`. If ResourceExhausted shows up, we may need to bump collector replicas or enable backpressure buffering.

maria: can you paste the dashboards/links you mentioned?

aj: sure — traces: https://jaeger.internal.redwood/search?service=prefetcher , logs: https://kibana.internal.redwood/app/logs?#/discover?_a=(query:(match:(service:(query:prefetcher,language:kuery)))) , collector metrics: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/otel/collector-overview?orgId=1&var-service=otel-collector

maria: perfect. i'll run the local reproduce with sampler=always_on and attach a few trace ids if i see the kvcache spans. if we confirm exporter limit, what's the mitigation?

aj: short-term: increase collector replicas for pref-pool and enable optimistic batching. Medium-term: enable prefix/KV caching on prefetcher to reduce heat, and add exporter retry/backoff configs in collector pipeline. I'll open a follow-up ticket if you confirm.

maria: sounds good. kendall, can you also review alert thresholds for `prefetcher_export_errors`? I think it flipped on a transient load test and alerted paging. We need a small cooldown or rate threshold to avoid noisy pages.

kendall: on it. I'll propose `for: 5m` and suppress if exporter error rate spike is <= 0.5% of total requests. Will post the rule diff here when ready. :memo:

oncall-bot: Assignment: created issue #INF-2028 and assigned to @aj and @kendall — https://issues.redwood/INF-2028

maria: thanks all — i'll update this thread with trace ids or a short paste of the jaeger links once i've reproduced. :thumbsup:
